name: Colorado Trail Day 6: Searle Pass → Turquoise Lake
description: Happened to be passing through Kokomo pass just as a thousand sheep were being herded through. They got there fast but then they took it slow. That was special. Searle Pass also pretty. Passed through Camp Hale - really have to read that book about the 10th mountain division. Sadly I don't think there will be cool divisions like that for me in the upcoming third world war. Bit of a rainy, sloggy afternoon overall. Looking forward to a zero day in Leadville with Justine.
